jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, CRM & GTM Systems
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager, CRM & GTM Systems based in United States.

This role owns the Lead-to-Opportunity domain within a complex Salesforce and go-to-market technology ecosystem.

You will shape the roadmap for how leads are captured, enriched, scored, routed, and converted into qualified pipeline.

Working at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Technology, you will turn business strategy into scalable system capabilities.

As one of the first product managers in a transforming product organization, you will help establish a proactive, roadmap-driven operating model.

The role combines strategic product ownership with hands-on discovery, prioritization, delivery oversight, and systems architecture collaboration.

You will also mentor business systems analysts and help elevate product thinking, processes, and capabilities across the team.

This is a high-impact, full-time remote opportunity for a product leader who can connect technology decisions directly to revenue outcomes.

Accountabilities

Own and maintain a multi-quarter product roadmap for the Lead-to-Opportunity domain, covering lead capture, enrichment, scoring, routing, conversion, opportunity processes, and the broader GTM technology ecosystem integrated with Salesforce.
Translate strategic priorities from Marketing, Sales Development, Revenue Operations, and GTM leadership into sequenced capabilities with clear outcomes, success metrics, and prioritization frameworks.
Define quarterly and half-year priorities while balancing new capabilities, platform stabilization, technical debt, capacity, and business impact.
Lead planning ceremonies in partnership with Engineering Managers and Business Systems Analysts, aligning team capacity with roadmap commitments and maintaining clear domain documentation.
Serve as the primary product voice for Lead-to-Opportunity and GTM Systems initiatives, partnering with Marketing, Marketing Operations, SDR/BDR leadership, Sales, and Revenue Operations.
Lead discovery sessions, requirements workshops, and business process design activities, translating complex marketing and GTM needs into actionable system specifications.
Resolve ambiguity between business requirements and technical implementation through structured decision-making, stakeholder alignment, documented trade-offs, and clear ownership.
Represent the domain in cross-functional planning and leadership reviews, translating technical constraints for business stakeholders and business context for engineering teams.
Mentor and develop Business Systems Analysts in product thinking, requirements definition, acceptance criteria, roadmap communication, and effective product practices.
Establish reusable product practices, templates, rituals, and standards while gradually increasing BSA ownership of roadmap areas through structured coaching and feedback.
Lead initiatives end-to-end across discovery, requirements, prioritization, solution design, UAT, launch, and post-launch measurement.
Maintain a healthy and prioritized backlog, evaluating requests based on business impact and effort while clearly communicating prioritization decisions to stakeholders.
Define and monitor success metrics such as lead response time, routing accuracy, lead-to-opportunity conversion, data quality, and SDR/BDR adoption.
Identify and manage dependencies across campaign operations, data enrichment providers, sales handoffs, and adjacent technology domains before they affect delivery.
Partner with Enterprise Architects and Engineering Managers on Salesforce and MarTech integrations, data enrichment pipelines, lead scoring and routing systems, API design, data models, and scalable integration patterns.
Evaluate Salesforce and connected MarTech platform roadmaps to identify opportunities to leverage native capabilities before pursuing custom solutions.
Maintain clear ownership and responsibilities across technical managers, BSAs, adjacent teams, and related technology domains as team structures and scope evolve.

Requirements

At least 7 years of experience in Salesforce product management, business systems analysis, Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations technology, or a related field, with demonstrated progression into product ownership.
Strong knowledge of Lead-to-Opportunity processes, including lead capture, enrichment, scoring, routing, conversion, and the connection between marketing execution and sales pipeline generation.
Hands-on familiarity with Salesforce Sales Cloud and GTM technologies such as Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, lead scoring and routing tools, data enrichment platforms, and intent providers.
Good understanding of quoting processes and how they connect with broader GTM and sales technology workflows.
Demonstrated ability to own and communicate multi-quarter internal product roadmaps to senior business and technology stakeholders.
Proven experience leading complex initiatives from discovery through launch and measurement while managing multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and cross-functional dependencies.
Sufficient technical fluency to collaborate effectively with engineering and architecture teams on APIs, data models, integrations, platform capabilities, and technical trade-offs without needing to write code.
Experience mentoring or upskilling analysts or Business Systems Analysts, with a genuine interest in developing product capability and helping others grow.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to non-technical executives and translate business requirements into clear technical specifications.
Strong stakeholder management, prioritization, and decision-making abilities, with the confidence to drive alignment and bring unresolved issues to closure.
Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and creating structure, processes, and direction where they do not yet exist.
Experience with AI-assisted development or product workflows, data governance and compliance for lead data, or people management is a plus.
Ability to connect product and technology decisions to measurable business and revenue outcomes.

Benefits

Annual base salary range of $104,800–$176,400 USD for eligible U.S. residents.
Additional compensation may include equity compensation and an employee stock purchase plan.
Eligibility for applicable incentive compensation depending on role and circumstances.
Benefits designed to support health, financial security, and overall well-being.

This is a senior architecture leadership role focused on designing scalable, secure, and highly available SaaS products across public cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. You will define technology strategy and architectural direction for complex products while partnering closely with product management and engineering leadership. The role has a strong emphasis on cloud-native, serverless, microservices, and event-driven architectures, particularly within AWS environments. You will help modernize products, guide engineering teams, and ensure solutions meet security, compliance, performance, and operational standards. The position offers significant influence over technology roadmaps, architecture governance, and adoption of emerging technologies such as AI/ML. Success requires deep technical expertise combined with strong communication, strategic thinking, and cross-functional leadership.

Accountabilities

Define and communicate the architectural vision and technology strategy for scalable, secure, and resilient SaaS products.
Architect and guide the implementation of cloud-native solutions across public cloud, hybrid, and on-premises deployment models, with a strong focus on AWS.
Design architectures that support elasticity, high availability, disaster recovery, security, data retention, and operational resilience.

Ensure solutions align with AWS Well-Architected Framework principles and appropriate cloud cost-management and optimization practices.
Lead architecture assessments, proofs of concept, design reviews, and the creation of living architecture artifacts throughout the governance lifecycle.

Support new products and releases by establishing appropriate cloud-native, serverless, and microservice architecture models.

jobs.description:
Overview

The Principal Product Architect will play a pivotal role in leading the design and architecture of scalable, secure, and highly available SaaS products, with an emphasis on public cloud design and deployment. This is a senior-level position requiring deep expertise in cloud technologies, SaaS models, and a proven track record of successful SaaS product deployment.

You will be responsible for defining the architectural vision, ensuring the scalability, security, and performance of products within your purview.

The Principal Product Architect partners with product management to ensure product roadmaps and release planning and align with the defined technology strategy. This role guides product engineering teams in the architecturally sound product design for public cloud, on-premises, and hybrid product deployments and maintains a product technology roadmap to achieve target state product alignment. This role focuses on technology assessments, proofs-of-concept, living architectural artifacts in the architecture governance lifecycle, and ensuring product design compliance with architecture, security, and operational standards.

This role provides thought leadership and, through the product technology roadmap, collaborates with product leadership to reconceive existing products to cloud native designs. This person engages with product engineering, technical architecture, security and operations to ensure compliance with reference product models.

The Principal Product Architect brings a blend of commercial SaaS product design, technical expertise, cross functional acumen, and translates complex requirements into actionable plans while promoting innovation, collaboration, and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Architectural Strategy
Defines and communicates the architectural vision and strategy for our healthcare SaaS products. Provides guidance to product engineering on design, operational optimization, deployment pipeline best practices, and automation opportunities
Architects and implements cloud-native SaaS products that perform at scale. Designs and manages the architecture of complex, cloud and hybrid products for elasticity, availability, and resiliency. Applies cloud-native design principles and employs best practices to ensure seamless integration of security, infrastructure, services, and applications in public cloud
Technical Oversight:
Maintains a holistic product technology scorecard including a technical roadmap, technical debt inventory, and compliance to product security, architecture, and operational reference models
Provides technical guidance and mentorship to engineering teams, ensuring best practices in software design and development. Fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning within the team
Scalability and Performance:
Champions the use of elastic, serverless cloud-native design concepts for highly scalable and resilient SaaS products, ensuring that products comply with AWS Well-Architected Framework and best practices.
Security and Compliance:
Ensures that all solutions adhere to industry standards and regulations, with a strong focus on data security and privacy.
Produces and shepherds architecture artifacts and designs through the architecture governance process
Collaboration:
Collaborates with stakeholders, clients, product management, engineering, technical platform architects, security, and operations teams to understand needs and translate them into actionable product architecture designs aligned with business goals.
Supports new products and product releases through serverless cloud-native design and microservice architecture models.
Defines the technical vision and roadmap for cloud-native SaaS products, ensuring alignment with strategic technology direction.
Collaborates with stakeholders and clients to understand their needs and translate them into actionable product architecture designs aligned with business goals
Collaborates with product engineering teams, technical architects, security and operations on product design, including serverless cloud-native design and microservice architecture models, in support of new products and product releases
Collaborates with product management, engineering, and operations teams to define the technical vision and technical roadmap for cloud-native SaaS products. Consults with Product Management to ensure the product roadmap incorporates strategic technology direction
Innovation:
Drives the adoption of emerging technologies and methodologies, such as microservices, serverless architectures, AI/ML, into the SaaS products. Stays abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, and incorporates them into the architectural roadmap

Qualifications

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Advanced critical thinking and problem solving skills as demonstrated by the ability to listen, collect, data, and make successful recommendations
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to lead technical discussions and influence decision-making processes related to product architecture
Ability to cultivate internal relationships and effectively engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders, share insights, and drive innovation
Strong knowledge of the appropriate use of AWS services and awareness of AWS cost management and optimization strategies
Ability to apply cloud architecture principles, including scalability, high availability, data retention, disaster recovery, and security best practices.
Intermediate knowledge of utilizing compliance frameworks and regulations (e.g., HITRUST, HIPAA, SOC 2)
Familiarity with Identity and Access models in on-prem and public cloud
Advanced proficiency in cloud-native serverless application design and development, microservices architecture, and event driven design patterns
Strong experience with monitoring and observability tools, including AWS CloudWatch
Demonstrated practice of emotional intelligence that is used to work effectively in a deadline driven, agile environment
Expertise in cloud service design patterns and architectures, including multi-region and multi-tenant SaaS models

Experience

10 years experience in application or solution architecture
8 years experience in cloud architecture, cloud engineering, cloud-native application design and deployment
5 year proven track record of successfully designing, deploying, and managing large-scale, complex serverless SaaS solutions on public cloud, preferably AWS.
5 years experience with modern development practices such as CI/CD, infrastructure as code (IaC), and DevOps

Preferred Experience

5 years experience as an architect in a commercial SaaS environment
5 years experience operating within an architecture governance framework

AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (or equivalent advanced certifications)

Master’s degree
Other relevant certifications (e.g., TOGAF, ITIL, Cloud Security) are a plus
